name: Layla
story: The backbone of the Eruditio Rangers who is also known as the Shining Star.

skills.name: Malefic Gun
skills.desc: Layla deals increased damage to enemies farther away from her (starting at 100% and increasing to 115% at 6 units away). This does not include Turrets.

skills.name: Malefic Bomb
skills.desc: Layla fires a Malefic Bomb in the target direction, dealing 200 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit (can Crit). Upon hitting an enemy, Layla's Basic Attacks and Void Projectile gain extra range for 3s, and she gains 60% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.2s. The duration of the Movement Speed boost is doubled if an enemy hero is hit.

skills.name: Void Projectile
skills.desc: Layla fires an orb of Malefic Energy at the target enemy that explodes on hit, dealing 170 (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to targets in the area and applying a Magic Mark on them for 3s. When Layla hits an enemy with a Magic Mark, she deals 100 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.25s.

skills.name: Destruction Rush
skills.desc: Passive: The range of Void Projectile and Basic Attacks is increased by 0.6 units. Layla's sight range is slightly increased each time this skill is upgraded. Active: Layla fires a blast of Malefic Energy in the target direction, dealing 500 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a line.
